correctness.rationale: The complete canonical-history list covers all legal two-step histories by separating overlapping starts from disjoint commuting starts; its cardinality is (n^2+5n-8)/2. For adjacent-unequal sources, different canonical left indices have different first equality-edge positions, and an exhaustive table provides a witness comparing adjacent source symbols for every within-index pair, proving injectivity for every n,q. An adjacent equality forces the two distinct local histories A_s and B_s to collapse, proving strict necessity. The finite checker directly recomputed 17,337 words and all template-pair witnesses for n=2..27.

value.rationale: The maximizer structure is a natural equality-case question for the already-sharp two-error sphere-packing geometry. The result determines all extremal sources and their exact q-ary count in every length, revealing nonalternating extremizers for q>=3 and an exponentially vanishing probability of maximal ambiguity under a uniform source. These distinctions cannot be obtained from the numerical maximum or the exhibited alternating family alone; the proof gives a useful finite local collision normal form.
